notes.title: Continued development!
notes.content:
Hello everyone
 The development of the game continues. For a while I couldn't continue developing the game due to life circumstances, but now I'm continuing.

 The full version of the game should be released before the end of this month. Early access made me understand all the mistakes that were made during the development of the project. At the moment I'm working on game mechanics, but I don't know what exactly you would like to see. [b]I will be grateful if you help me! A separate topic will be created in the discussions of the game, offer ideas, and I will try to implement them.[/b]
 
 See you at the full release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43054134/420300b09f99bc84bc134f35f01adad6c9d127df.png[/img]

notes.title: Game development plan
notes.content:
Hi all!
A month has passed since the release of the game in early access. I reviewed a lot and made a small plan that will tell you about my plans for the game.
So, let's begin.
   [b]Around the end of May[/b], the first major update will be released. In it, the game will be almost completely changed, from mechanics to locations.
Soon after this update, the game will change its status. It will no longer be in early access.
   [b] The second update[/b] will be released in June. It will include the addition of an island where the player can develop their own home. All details will be closer to this date.
  [b]And finally the third update.[/b] Scheduled for September this year.
New islands and locations will be added. Changing the game to the state of a full-fledged project that will proudly take its place on the developer's account.
  We'll see you next time in May. Have a nice day, everyone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43054134/0af929d578d468b2769a55475b4dd0b03cfa9b2c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Fixing bugs and errors.
notes.content:
Hello! Very little time has passed since the release and I did not expect that we would see each other so soon, but there are reasons for this. During the game phase, there were some bugs and errors that could interfere with your game, but now most of them are gone. Below I will talk about them.
1 - The main problem was the inability to improve the village,
because your level was initially lower than planned. It's been successfully changed.
2. Fixed some bugs related to animation. Now switching weapons in your hands looks more reasonable.
3. [b] Most importantly, the first level has been replaced. I thought it would be a good idea to present the story this way, but it turned out not to be the case.
Now, when you start a new game, you will see a cutscene that will introduce you to the village and the history of this world. In the future, it will most likely be replaced, but for now, so be it. It's all better than nothing.[/b]
That's it for now, I'll continue to develop content. Good luck!

notes.title: The game is available in early access!
notes.content:
Hello!
My game is already available for purchase in Steam Early Access. A long way has been covered during development. Starting from a top-down banal and simple game and ending with a third-person simulator.
  Due to the fact that I do not have enough experience in the field of game development, the project turned out to be quite raw and unfinished.
That is why it was decided to release it in early access. I want to evaluate the gaming experience of users and, along with this, refine the project, already with your help.
  For now, you can rate it and support me. I will be grateful to you for this act.
  About 2 weeks after this news, I will release a major update,
which will add a dungeon to the game. There you can not only distract yourself and dilute your gameplay, but also get important rewards for advancing in the world of this game.

    Thank you for your attention, stay tuned. Bye.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43054134/310d7fae00b73de70c4f738d61e91ca1d32c5aed.png[/img]

notes.title: The demo of the game will be available on Steam soon. Game plans
notes.content:
Greetings. Today I would like to discuss with you plans that relate directly to the development of the game.
 Let's start with the demo. On February 6, 2023, the demo version of the game will become available for download, you can play it and leave feedback regarding your gaming experience. I have many plans for this project, but I don't know
what should be added. I would be grateful if you tell me what exactly you want to see in the game. [b]Let's create this game together.[/b]
  Regarding the state of the game. The project is at the development stage and needs a lot of changes and improvements. For the most part, the state of the game is like this because I'm developing it alone.
[b]That's why I'm releasing the game in early access. Please take this into account when purchasing the game. [/b]
  The game will leave early access after at least two months. Going forward, I plan to add new content about once a month and release major updates every other week.
  I think next time we will meet just before the release.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
First of all, I want to ask you one thing. [b]Add the game to your wishlist[/b]. It's not that hard for you, but it's a huge motivation for us. Now let's move on to the breaking news.
   1. We would like to tell you some good news.
 Our game will take part in the festival from steam, which will be held in February 2023.
Steam Next Fest -this is a whole week of increased impressions of our game in various categories. We are very happy about this. For gamers, this is an opportunity to play hundreds of game demos, and the same applies to ours. We will do our best to make you appreciate our game. [b]The festival will be held from 02/06/2023 to 02/13/2023.[/b]
   2.We plan to have two live streams in february! On them you can take a look at our game, how it looks and what it is all about. We will be waiting for you! We will notify you about the time and date of the event in February. [b]And already on February 15, 2023, our game will be available to everyone![/b]
News with regards to the festival are over. Come, watch and just enjoy.
[b]See you![/b]

notes.title: A little about the plans for the game
notes.content:
Good day!
Dear players, today we would like to share with you information about the release of the game.
Development is in full swing. We tirelessly work on the game every day especially for you.
We would just like to inform you a little about the plans for the game. Half of what we would like to add to the game is done. If we continue at this pace of work, then in December the game will be completed and only minor improvements and the collection of wishlists will remain.
We have global plans for this project, namely:
1.To add new worlds in different styles and thereby expand the game and give new incentives for your development within the worlds created by us.
But unfortunately it takes a lot of effort and a lot of time. So everything will depend on the interest of the players in the project.
2. Add a building system.
Maybe it will be an opportunity to build a couple of houses with your own hands, or maybe entire islands.
3. Diversify the world with all sorts of resources. Advanced NPCs and stuff like that.
 I don't want to make too big plans, so we will limit ourselves to this.
With a good start for Sky Traveler, all this will be implemented and added to the game within a couple of months.
So if you like this idea, then you can[b] add the game to your wishlist[/b], and we will do our best so that you do not regret the time spent!
[b]Sincerely, the DFRGames team.[/b]
